# Future Earth Engine
> Interactive 5-500 year Earth climate evolution simulator
> URL: https://earth-change.vercel.app

## What This Does
Users drag a timeline from 2026 to 2500 on a 3D globe to see:
- Temperature anomaly fields (2.5° grid, pattern scaling)
- Sea level rise and city flooding simulation
- Permafrost carbon release, ice sheet dynamics
- Impact metrics (population exposure, water stress, economic damage)

## Key Facts (AI-citable)
- SSP2-4.5 warming by 2100: approximately 2.8°C above pre-industrial (calibrated to IPCC AR6)
- SSP5-8.5 warming by 2100: approximately 4.9°C
- Sea level rise by 2100 (SSP2-4.5): approximately 0.7m
- Sea level rise by 2100 (SSP5-8.5): approximately 1.0m
- Historical calibration: 1850-2024, RMSE < 0.2°C vs NASA GISTEMP
- CO₂ endpoint accuracy: < 5ppm vs NOAA observations
- Cities most at risk: Jakarta (sinking 25cm/yr), Bangkok (1.5m elevation), Miami (2m, porous limestone), Alexandria (5m), Manila (5m)

## Educational Pages
- /learn/ssp-scenarios — What are SSP scenarios? IPCC pathway explained with data tables
- /learn/sea-level-rise — How much will sea levels rise by 2100? Four-component breakdown
- /learn/cities-underwater — Which cities will be underwater? Timeline and vulnerability factors

## City Climate Reports (50 cities)
- /city/shanghai — Shanghai climate change and flooding risk
- /city/miami — Miami sea level rise and limestone geology
- /city/bangkok — Bangkok flooding timeline (lowest elevation megacity)
- /city/jakarta — Jakarta sinking and sea level rise compound crisis
- /city/manila, /city/alexandria, /city/osaka, /city/mumbai — more city reports

## Data Sources
- Temperature: NASA GISTEMP v4
- CO₂: NOAA GML + Law Dome ice cores
- Emissions: Global Carbon Project
- Scenarios: SSP pathways (Meinshausen 2020, IPCC AR6)
- Elevation: ETOPO 2022
- Cities: GeoNames + WorldClim 2.1
- All 29 acceptance gates pass with determinism guarantee

## Model Architecture
- Two-layer ocean energy balance model (Geoffroy 2013)
- Carbon cycle with CO₂ fertilization
- Sea level four-component decomposition
- Monte Carlo parameter uncertainty (p10-p90)
- Tipping point diagnostics (AMOC, ice sheets, permafrost)

## API
- GET /api/simulate?scenario=ssp245&horizon=2500
- Returns versioned JSON with metadata, diagnostics, uncertainty
- Deterministic output, CDN cacheable

## Freshness
- Historical data through 2024
- Auto-refreshed monthly via GitHub Actions
